verdict.rationale: The evidence shows ESOP management, vesting schedules, e-signed certificates, electronic share issuance and Form 3921 filing. None of it documents an employee-facing online option exercise flow with payment and automatic share issuance. Those are adjacent admin-side features, not the exercise capability itself.

support.subject: As an employee, I can exercise my vested options online — including payment and the resulting share issuance — without paper forms
